root_text:
There is a new outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) similar to COVID-19 in China. 

Hospitals are currently being overrun by patients, but the Chinese government is providing little or no details of the outbreak to the rest of the world

nodes.text:
There is a new outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) similar to COVID-19 in China. 

Hospitals are currently being overrun by patients, but the Chinese government is providing little or no details of the outbreak to the rest of the world. 

What measures is our Govt taking?
